question: How do pre-conventional beings attain varied subjecthood?
premises: Even pre-conventional beings possess their own consciousness.
This consciousness has an uncontrived formative essence and is both differentiated and undifferentiated.
Relying on this consciousness, they attain varied subjecthood.
inference: By relying on their innate, both-differentiated-and-undifferentiated consciousness, pre-conventional beings attain varied forms of subjecthood.
plain_english: Even they, relying on this own consciousness of theirs—whose essence is an uncontrived impression and which is both differentiated and undifferentiated—attain a varied state of being knowers.
